en.headline: Sportfest Hong Kong continues at HKCEC with pickleball and new sports trials
en.dek: The three-day sports expo under the theme “Dare to Sport Dai Pai Dong” runs until Sunday, offering free experiences of emerging sports alongside competitions and a youth volleyball final.
body: Sportfest Hong Kong 2026 is under way at Hall 3DE of the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, continuing through Sunday under the theme “Dare to Sport Dai Pai Dong”.

Organisers said the event blends sports experiences with local dai pai dong culture. Highlights include a pickleball arena with challenges and beginner classes, an all-round new-sports zone featuring spikeball, teqvoly, ground snowboarding and disc golf, plus an inter-school e-cycling challenge and the V.Cares Youth Volleyball Training Programme final.

Admission costs HK$30, with free entry for children aged 12 or under, senior citizens aged 60 or above and people with disabilities. Opening hours are 10:30 am to 7:30 pm on Saturday and 10 am to 7 pm on Sunday. Workshops and competitions require separate registration via the official website.

The event opened on Friday with appearances by local girl group Lolly Talk and Hong Kong marathon runner Wong Cheuk-ning. Organisers described it as an accessible sports party open to participants of all levels and budgets.

zh.headline: 香港運動節會展續舉行 設匹克球及新興運動體驗
zh.dek: 以「敢運動大排檔」為主題的三天運動博覽進行至周日，提供匹克球挑戰、新興運動試玩及青年排球決賽等。
body: 「香港運動節2026」正於香港會議展覽中心展覽廳3DE舉行，活動進行至周日，主題為「敢運動大排檔」。
主辦方表示，活動將運動體驗與本地大排檔文化結合。焦點包括匹克球競技場的挑戰賽及新手班、全方位新興運動體驗區（涵蓋圓網球、桌上排球、平地單板滑雪及飛盤高爾夫等），以及電競單車挑戰賽和V.Cares青年排球訓練計劃決賽。
入場費30元，12歲或以下兒童、60歲或以上長者及殘疾人士免費。周六開放時間為上午10時30分至晚上7時30分，周日為上午10時至晚上7時。體驗班及賽事須另行透過官方網站報名。
活動周五開幕，本地女團Lolly Talk成員及港隊馬拉松代表黃卓寧出席啟動禮。主辦方形容這是一場任何人都可以「落場」參與的運動派對。
